data.one_liner: A form field widget for picking dates and times with adaptive Material and Cupertino dialogs
data.what_it_does: Provides DateTimeField and DateTimeFormField widgets that let users select a date, time, or both. It also offers global functions to show adaptive, Material, or Cupertino pickers directly.
use_when: You need a date or time picker inside a form
You want platform‑adaptive dialogs without custom implementation
You want to disable the field via an enabled flag
avoid_when: You need a custom picker UI that differs from the standard Material/Cupertino styles
You are building a non‑Flutter project
strengths: Easy to integrate with Flutter forms
Supports both Material and Cupertino styles out of the box
Offers global functions for standalone pickers
Provides an enabled flag to disable the field
weaknesses: No support for custom picker themes beyond basic decoration
data.setup_notes: Add date_field to pubspec, run flutter pub get, import package, optionally call findSystemLocale() for locale support
data.minimal_example:
DateTimeFormField(
  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Select date'),
  firstDate: DateTime.now(),
  lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365)),
  onChanged: (value) => print(value),
)
